description: Read an XRPL ledger header and metadata, optionally including its transactions. Omit ledger_index to use the current validated ledger; set transactions=true to include transactions and expand=true to return full transaction objects. Use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data instead for raw ledger-state objects.

expand.description: Whether returned transactions should be expanded into full transaction objects.
expand.title: Expand

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or ledger selector. Omit to use the current validated ledger.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

transactions.description: Whether to include transactions contained in the requested ledger.
transactions.title: Transactions

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger
